NETWORK.NAME: EstablishedCaseClozapine_R7_draft
NETWORK.PROPERTY: clinical_validity=none; reference tables are synthetic structural placeholders, not patient estimates
ordering_contract=child state fastest, last declared parent next, first parent slowest

drafting_lead=BNs/BN-07.xml inference-disabled draft; registration-scoped subset retained verbatim for states and edges; ongoing-treatment nodes deferred to follow-up F5; missing root priors added and deterministic 0-1 workflow tables replaced with soft synthetic placeholders preserving each deterministic argmax
scope=registration established-case only; distinct package identity from F5 no_improvement_clozapine even where BN-07 is a shared lead

VARIABLE.NAME: SchizophreniaEstablished
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Schizophrenia established (clinician-confirmed)
definition=Clinician-confirmed schizophrenia. No means assessed and not confirmed; not missing diagnostic data
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: PersistentSignificantSymptoms
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Persistent significant symptoms (current, clinician judgment)
definition=Current clinically significant residual symptoms despite treatment; record symptom domains and validated scale/version. A 20 percent improvement does not automatically make this No
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: Trial1Assessment
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Trial 1 assessment (clinician category, status only)

definition=One documented prior antipsychotic trial as a clinician adequacy category. Adequate means therapeutic exposure for at least 6 weeks with adherence evidence per TRRIP reference; suboptimal includes partial response with persistent symptoms. TruncatedByIntolerance takes precedence over inadequate exposure. Status only: no dose, unit, route, frequency, or level is stored
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: Trial2Assessment
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Trial 2 assessment (clinician category, status only)
definition=One documented prior antipsychotic trial as a clinician adequacy category, independent of Trial 1. Same category meanings as Trial 1. Status only; no regimen detail is stored
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: TrialsUseDifferentDrugs
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Trials use different drugs
definition=The two assessed trials used different antipsychotic agents; different classes are not mandatory in this draft
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: SymptomsAtLeast12Weeks
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Symptoms at least 12 weeks (duration feature)
definition=Significant symptoms persisted for at least 12 weeks in total; duration evidence documented. Additional research feature, not a clinical eligibility gate by itself
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: ModerateSymptomsAndFunctionalImpairment
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Moderate symptoms and functional impairment (severity feature)
definition=Both symptom severity and functional impairment at least moderate on validated measures; source gives SOFAS below 60 as functioning example. Not a universal clinical eligibility gate
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: UrgentSafetyConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Urgent safety concern (current)

definition=Clinician identifies need for urgent assessment: suspected severe neutropenia, myocarditis/NMS, severe or unresolved constipation, or acute psychiatric danger. Nonexhaustive externally assessed input; Absent is not proof of safety
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: ClozapineTreatmentStatus
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Clozapine treatment status
definition=CurrentTreatment takes precedence if presently receiving clozapine; otherwise past exposure versus never treated. Status only; no dose, duration, route or frequency
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: WillingToDiscussClozapine
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Willing to discuss clozapine
definition=Patient currently willing to discuss clozapine; not consent to treatment. No prompts permanent exclusion
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: ClozapineMonitoringPlanAvailable
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Clozapine monitoring plan available
definition=Feasible clinician-reviewed monitoring and follow-up plan available per current local guidance. No means a documented planning or logistical gap, not an absolute contraindication
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: ClozapineInitiationDiscussionAppropriate
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Clozapine initiation discussion appropriate (medical review)
definition=Clinician has completed individualized contraindication, interaction and medical risk review and considers initiation discussion appropriate; no autonomous medical clearance
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: TwoAdequateSuboptimalTrials
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Two adequate suboptimal trials (derived flag)
definition=Summary of two different adequate trials with inadequate clinical response. Yes iff both trials AdequateSuboptimalResponse and different drugs Yes
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: TreatmentResistantSchizophreniaReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Treatment-resistant schizophrenia review (indication flag)

definition=Flag to review treatment-resistant schizophrenia and clozapine; not definitive TRS diagnosis or prescription. Triggered iff schizophrenia established, persistent symptoms, and two adequate suboptimal trials
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AdditionalResearchFeatures
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Additional research features (parallel info)
definition=Additional duration/severity/function features described by TRRIP; not certification of full TRRIP criteria and deliberately not a parent gating clinical review
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: PriorTrialAdequacyReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Prior trial adequacy review (parallel flag)
definition=Review inadequate treatment exposure or intolerance before classifying failed trials as resistance. Triggered iff either trial inadequate exposure or truncated by intolerance
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: ClozapineInitiationDiscussionPreparation
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Clozapine initiation discussion preparation (parallel flag)
definition=Readiness to discuss a potential initiation plan, not permission to prescribe. PreparedForDiscussion iff willing, monitoring plan, and medical review all Yes
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: TreatmentResistanceClozapineReviewPathway
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Treatment-resistance clozapine review pathway (workflow output)

definition=Proposed workflow routing with urgent assessment first. Current or prior clozapine branches preserve the separate indication flag and require clinician interpretation; no branch authorizes starting, restarting, continuing or stopping treatment
source=BNs/BN-07.xml retained for review; mapping and periods in manifest.json
status=proposed_mapping_for_review
